verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine is a game engine/development tool with no concept of 'production data' or live production environments to isolate from — this axis (sandbox vs. production data separation) is designed for SaaS/agentic data products, not a rendering/authoring engine. Evidence about PIE testing (unreal-docs-9) or command-line test flags relates to in-editor level testing, not production-data isolation, so the story is a category error for this product type.
